title: Shared definitions
description: Primitives reused across the record schemas. Nothing here is a record in its own right.

semver.description: Rule set and recipe versions. Major.minor.patch, no pre-release suffixes.

user_id.description: Identity from company SSO. A ruling is worthless without a real one behind it.

equipment_class.description: Deliberately not a closed enum. The architecture doc calls this an enum and gives `switchboard` as an example, but the curator extends the safety-relevant lists per project, and a closed set here would mean a schema change for every new class on every project. Constrained to snake_case so the tag reconciler can normalize against it.

criticality.description: Closed by design. This is the safety control: `safety` never auto-clears and never self-clears, and a value outside this set must not validate.

location.description: Model coordinates stay optional until scan integration in Phase 4.

region.description: A rectangle on one piece of evidence, normalized 0-1 so it survives resizing.

capture_recipe_ref.description: Recipes are versioned and shared across projects; a requirement may reference more than one.

verdict.description: The one verdict vocabulary, shared by the Rule Registry and Inspection Understudy. Every judgement in either system is one of these four, whoever or whatever made it: a grader, a reviewer, or a learner committing to a call before the reveal. 'indeterminate' is a first-class answer, not a failure to answer, and it carries a verdict_reason saying which kind it is. 'not_visible' is narrower: the thing could not be seen, so no judgement about the installation was possible at all.

verdict_reason.description: Which kind of 'indeterminate' this is. Required when verdict is 'indeterminate' and absent otherwise. These three carry the meanings that used to be separate verdicts in Understudy: a grader without enough to go on, a reviewer sending the photograph back, and a learner who honestly does not know.
